nodeGroups.name: Validate order
nodeGroups.description: Checks order status, products, totals, payment and duplicates; any failure goes to a human.

nodeGroups.name: Confirm stock availability
nodeGroups.description: Hands the order to Inventory & Warehouse and checks each item against mock stock levels.

nodeGroups.name: Prepare order in warehouse
nodeGroups.description: Reserves stock, updates inventory, opens a task for staff to pick, verify and pack, then waits for ready (max 5 checks).

nodeGroups.name: Ship & track delivery
nodeGroups.description: Polls the courier every 5s (max 5 checks); in-transit and delayed re-check, delivered, exceptions and timeout leave the loop.

nodeGroups.name: Confirm delivery & reconcile
nodeGroups.description: On delivery, marks the order delivered, notifies the customer, reconciles payment and alerts finance on any mismatch.
